paragraphs: He is mentioned in the Jerusalem Talmud, Bava Batra, chapter 4, halakhah 8, and Avodah Zarah, chapter 1, halakhah 1, speaking in Rav’s name.[^1][^2]

notes.text: The Guggenheimer digital texts of Jerusalem Talmud Bava Batra 4:8 and Avodah Zarah 1:1 have Rabbi Ba bar Tavlai. The supplied heading’s Abba form is retained.

Both saved Guggenheimer passages, Bava Batra4:8 and Avodah Zarah1:1, have Rabbi Ba bar Tavlai reporting Rav. Hyman’s heading has Abba rather than Ba; it stays distinct and its abbreviation remains R' without transferring rank across the name variant. Body Rav is explicit and the two named Jerusalem Talmud locators are supported.
